Half Price Books has acquired the former Soundwaves space at 3509 Montrose Blvd. in Houston's Montrose neighborhood, returning to the area five years after closing. The new store is expected to open next year.

Italian restaurant Tavola in Houston's Uptown neighborhood has closed after 3 years, as announced by owner The Bastion Collection on social media. No further details on the closure date or reason are provided in the article.

Greenwich Grill at the Mill Waterfall Glenville is set to open July 15 at 6:00 PM in the space formerly known as Centro. The upscale-casual American grill features waterfall views, an expansive patio, elevated classics, and a seasonal menu.

Asian-inspired department store Teso Life has opened at 9278 Arlington Expy. in Jacksonville, which is now the largest Teso Life location in the U.S. No further details on the opening date are provided in the article.

Costco has purchased land at 12649 Clayton Boulevard in Clayton, North Carolina, where it will anchor a developing shopping center in what will be the first Costco in Johnston County. The $100 million project includes a 166,000-square-foot warehouse and a 24-pump gas station.

Pancheros Mexican Grill will open its seventh Missouri location in Lebanon on July 21 at 1555 S. Jefferson Ave. The location is owned and operated by the Davis Fresh-Mex franchise and will be open from 10:30 a.m. to 10 p.m. daily.

Starling Cards & Comics held a ribbon-cutting ceremony at its new Uptown Martinsville location in the former McCollum-Ferrell building, completing a nearly two-year effort. The shop offers trading cards, comics, tabletop games, collectibles, and events for players and collectors.

Those cuts followed nearly 1,000 closures in 2024, reducing the chain's footprint from over 8,359 locations to about 7,100.
